name: Beef & Barley Soup
description: A hearty beef and barley soup with vegetables and tomato, ideal for freezing and reheating.
recipeIngredient: 3 cups cooked roast beef (or 2-3 cups chopped hamburg meat)
½ cup pearl or pot barley

recipeInstructions.text: Heat water and bouillon cubes in a large pot, stirring until dissolved.
Add remaining ingredients except beef and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 1½ hours.
Add beef and simmer for an additional ½ hour.

keywords: beef barley soup, hearty soup, freezer-friendly

_similar.name: Beef and Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, sautéed celery and onion, and cooked rice, all baked in a tomato soup sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté celery and onion in butter until soft and tender.
Place rice in a greased 1½ quart casserole dish.
Top the rice with the celery mixture.
Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned.
Arrange the cooked beef on top of the celery mixture.
Combine the tomato soup with water and pour over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated 325°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, rice casserole, comfort food

_similar.name: Microwave Corn Chowder
_similar.description: A creamy corn chowder made in the microwave with potatoes, carrots, celery, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: 2 cans (14¾ oz each) cream style corn

recipeInstructions.text: Place water in a 2-quart microwave-safe dish; cover and heat until boiling.
Add potatoes, carrots, celery, onion, salt, and pepper. Cook, uncovered, on high for 8 to 10 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender; set aside (do not drain).
In a 3-quart dish, microwave butter on high for 50 to 60 seconds or until melted.
Stir in flour until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Cook, uncovered, on high for 6 to 7 minutes or until thickened, stirring every 2 minutes.
Add the cheese. Heat for 1 to 1½ minutes or until the cheese is melted.
Stir in corn and reserved vegetables. Cook on high for 2 to 3 minutes or until heated through.

_similar.keywords: microwave corn chowder, creamy soup, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Cheese & Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli and cheese soup with a smooth texture.
recipeIngredient: 3 cups cooked broccoli (fresh or partially aged)

recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan and cook onions until tender, but not brown.
Whisk in chicken broth and broccoli. Bring to a boil.
Add flour mixture and cook for 3 minutes.
Return to heat and simmer for 15 minutes, reducing heat. Do not boil.
Puree the mixture until smooth.
Heat with milk, cheese, and seasonings.

_similar.keywords: broccoli soup, cheese soup, creamy soup

_similar.name: Corn Chowder
_similar.description: A creamy corn chowder with bacon, potatoes, and a touch of milk.
recipeIngredient: 1½ cups frozen or fresh corn kernels

recipeInstructions.text: Chop bacon and sauté in a large heavy pot with onions for 5 minutes.
Add celery and cook until onions are transparent.
Stir in flour, salt, and pepper. Cook for 4 minutes.
Gradually blend in hot stock, then add potatoes. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add corn and simmer for another 10 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
Scald milk and add to soup for desired consistency.

_similar.keywords: corn chowder, creamy soup, bacon soup
